name: Perturbation Theory (Time-Independent and Time-Dependent)
methods: Identify unperturbed Hamiltonian H0 and small perturbation H'
Compute first-order energy shift by sandwiching H' between unperturbed eigenstates
Diagonalize degenerate subspace for degenerate energy levels
Apply Fermi's Golden Rule for transitions induced by time-dependent perturbations
problem_types: Radiative transition rates and absorption cross-sections
pitfalls: Applying non-degenerate perturbation formulas when unperturbed states are degenerate
Neglecting higher-order terms when perturbation magnitude is not small compared to level spacing
